description: Use this when the user asks to attach a JPEG, PNG, or WebP image to an existing Familia task or plan. Provide either dataUrl or base64Data plus mimeType. Do not use for non-image files.

base64Data.description: Raw base64 image bytes when dataUrl is not provided.

fileName.description: Optional image filename shown in attachment metadata.

mimeType.description: Required when base64Data is provided without a dataUrl.

replaceExistingPhoto.description: When true, replaces the latest existing photo attachment for the target.

targetId.description: Task id when targetType is task, or plan item id when targetType is plan.

targetType.description: Type of Familia item that should receive the image.

timezone.description: IANA timezone used by the backend request.

name: familia_attach_image
title: Attach image
